Optional — doesn't answer the question below
What do you want to do?
Wait for Raw Material
Nothing starts until the material arrives. Safest choice — no partial batches to track, but the order is on hold until then.
Start Partial Production
Begin now with the quantity the stock on hand actually supports. The remaining quantity becomes a separate linked order, produced once more material is available.
Override & Continue
Commit to the full order quantity right now, even without confirmed material in hand. Requires a reason and is logged for audit — use only when you're confident the material will be available in time.
Order raw material
Quantity defaults to the shortfall but can be increased. This goes into the Procurement queue — Admin selects the vendor and rate, then sends the PO.
